title: LL-979: Forest Moon Canopy Command
description: A 1979 Classic Space expedition built by Ewoks: three timber observatories with blue conical roofs, yellow glazing and planetary logos; a descending rope bridge; a leaf-camouflaged delta scout; ladders, cargo hoist and treetop radar. Studded landing surfaces recall the original space sets, while tiled timber paths guide the canopy crew.
